Any-format → WebP converter (plan 13). decodeImage sniffs magic bytes and decodes any supported format to a DynamicImage; convertToWebp / fluent WebpRequest re-encode as WebP. Animated GIF / multi-page TIFF / multi-image ICO: first frame only. 16-bit / float32 sources auto-downconvert to 8-bit (never blank output).

Decode any supported file via a read-only mmap window (no readFile + copy: the mapped bytes are passed as openArray views straight into the decoders). Heif copies once internally (other agent owns that seq API); all other formats are zero-copy on input.

    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Convert any DynamicImage variant to 8-bit RGBA. 16-bit channels map exactly (v div 257: 0→0, 65535→255); float32 clamps 0,1 then scales (HDR: clamp, no tone mapping in v1). Never blanks: every variant is handled, unlike toRgba8.
